scope: Already fixed approved benchmark plans: assignments, queues and planned starts are given. Derive exact conditional deadline contracts and the limit of support-only section-existence criteria. No new plan generation.
original_criterion: The same useful certified external production result at lower complete cost than the strongest reasonable direct method, or a better result at comparable complete cost.
candidate_mechanism: Deadline-restricted local execution relations over actual machine calendars, with compatible global sections; existence/cohomological obstructions computed from support alone.
strong_baselines: calendar-aware backward DAG propagation and residuation
minimal conflict/cut sets and SAT diagnosis
weighted counting, BDD and Markov inference for probabilities
probability_obstruction_scope: A support-only invariant cannot produce an MTTR-dependent 95% boundary when support and restriction maps are unchanged. This does not forbid exact conditional failure sets, deadline contracts, weighted methods or a separate algorithmic improvement.
execution: Mathematical analysis with read-only checks of sealed input prerequisites in Actions. No new execution engine, benchmark, production simulation or risk estimate.
